text:
maria: Morning — quick planning for Wed train. Proposal: try a paired-lanes pattern (runtime-service + model-router + small infra migration) in one slot to reduce cross-slot ripple. 09:00 UTC slot open. Who can own?

josh: I can cover but prefer 09:30 if possible (timezone). Any CI cliffs we should know about?

lee: 09:00 works for me. Which exact services are we bundling?

maria: Pairing: runtime-service + model-router + a small, backwards-compatible DB schema change. Plan: run infra migrate as a pre-step (no blocking), then canary model-router at 10% for 10m, then 30% for 10m, then full. Smoke owner: @sam. Rollback plan: config flip + model-router rollback + runtime-service undo.

sam: I'll be smoke owner. Smoke checklist (short): health endpoints, perf sanity, traces, logs tail 10m, basic prompt smoke set. Ping me 15m before slot.

sam: ```
# quick smoke commands
curl -f https://prod/runtime/health || echo "health fail"
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/runtime-service
# quick sanity for router
curl -H 'x-user: smoke' -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://prod/model-router/api/generate | jq .status
```

tia: heads up — infra PR includes a tiny schema migration that takes ~5-10m. It's backward-compatible but we should do migration before canary traffic.

josh: can we start model-router canary at 10% instead of 20%? past regressions hit on larger jumps.

lee: agree with smaller canary. Also ask QA to run prompt set #42 after the 10% window. @maria can you queue the eval?

maria: will create an eval run and the pre-deploy checklist. @deploy-bot schedule slot for 2025-02-12 09:00 UTC for this paired deploy (owners: maria + lee).

deploy-bot: Scheduled: 2025-02-12 09:00 UTC slot reserved for @maria/@lee. Reminder +15m. Deploy run id: deploy-20250212-09-00-01.

sam: If rollback needed, execute (quick):
```
redwood deploy rollback --service model-router --to-last-good
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/runtime-service
# revert infra config: redwood infra apply --config infra/rollback-config.yaml
```

tia: capacity note: reserve 2 extra nodes during canary window to avoid transient OOM. @ops-oncall can you allocate?

ops-oncall: Allocating +2 nodes for 09:00->09:45 UTC. Bumping monitoring thresholds for 30m after canary. Pager on for the slot.

josh: I'll run final CI & preflight and ping 20m before. If anything blocks, we move to 10:00 slot — otherwise go ahead.

maria: thanks — created checklist doc https://redwood.internal/ops/release-checklist/1755551234 and added owners/steps. I'll post a 15m reminder in this thread. :thumbsup:
